Privacy Policy

Last updated: OWNER_CONFIRM before publishing

Who we are

This website is operated by NextGen Blinds. Questions about this policy can be sent to admin@nextgenblinds.com or by calling 561-332-8091.

What we collect

When you request a consultation, we collect the details you enter: your name, ZIP code, preferred contact method, phone number and/or email, and any optional project details you add. We also record the page you submitted from and, if present, the campaign tags in the link that brought you here, so we know which pages are useful.

How we use it

We use your details to respond to your request, schedule and carry out your consultation, and prepare a proposal. We don't sell your information. We won't send you marketing messages unless you separately agree to receive them.

Who processes it

Your request is stored by Netlify, which hosts this website, and emailed to our team through Netlify's form notifications. Netlify processes it on our behalf and filters spam automatically.

How long we keep it

OWNER_CONFIRM: retention period for consultation requests that do and do not become customers.

Cookies and analytics

This site does not currently use advertising pixels or third-party analytics. It uses your browser's session storage to keep your request reference and campaign tags during your visit. If analytics or advertising tools are added, this policy and any required consent choices will be updated first.

Your choices

You can ask us to access, correct, or delete the information you submitted by contacting us at the details above.
